input.title: Caret is moved to the end of the text when undoing applied Background Color
input.body: ## Step to Reproduce 1. Create Thought `Welcome to the Jungle` 4. Place the caret in the middle of the text for easy spotting 5. Apply Red Background Color 6. Click Undo ## Current behavior Background Color is undone but the caret is moved to the end of the Notes text. This is also valid for undoing Font Color applied. Valid for Mobile and Desktop platforms **Video:** https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6112be8c-8c9b-40b2-a505-629499d8cdf3 ## Expected behavior Caret should stay where it left off. _Originally posted by @BayuAri in https://github.com/cybersemics/em/issues/4628#issuecomment-4970759373_
